case.original_facts: Frozen sequences, raw alignments, source records, native coordinates, candidate masks/scores and original metrics.
case.biological_judgment: Alignment event confidence and flags; pairwise absence is not proven evolutionary deletion direction, permissive WT deletion or function.
case.model_prediction: Predicted shortened-variant coordinates and frozen computational quality metrics; no activity or binding assay.

contact_status_definition: All native finite-CA pairs with distance<8A and WT sequence separation>=3; explicit frozen WT-to-edit correspondence; statuses deleted_endpoint, retained_not_recovered, recovered, unknown. Immutable full-WT contact denominator.
ROI_rule: Choose adopted natural event with maximal number of native contacts to outside the event, then lowest start coordinate. ROI = event plus immediate anchors and native8A neighbors of the anchors; no predicted-quality based ROI search.
biological_scope: WT181 vs homolog183; qcov.978/tcov.94; several weak-identity flanks retained as ambiguity
